title: Relation graphs of the sedenion algebra
summary: Let $\mathbb{S}$ denote the algebra of the sedenions, and $Γ_O(\mathbb{S})$ denote its orthogonality graph. We observe that any pair of zero divisors in $\mathbb{S}$ produces a double hexagon in $Γ_O(\mathbb{S})$. The set of vertices of a double hexagon can be extended to a basis of $\mathbb{S}$ which has a convenient multiplication table. We describe explicitly the set of vertices of an arbitrary connected component of $Γ_O(\mathbb{S})$ and find its diameter.
